caption: The drawing is an aerial, map-like view of an estate, predominantly illustrated in shades of green to depict various areas of grass, trees, and shrubbery, with the estate's house located near the bottom center. The house has a roof rendered in tones of brown and red, and it is rectangular with a perpendicular wing, surrounded by decorative garden plots in patterns of green, outlined with curved paths in pale yellow. A curved driveway leads to the house from the bottom left, passing fields or lawns in lighter green. Trees of varying shapes and shades of green, some with blueish tones, line the curving main road that arcs from the bottom left to the top right and encircles the estate. To the upper left of the house, there is a circular area with a conical tree or topiary in the center, surrounded by pinkish and white flowers. Smaller structures or garden elements appear near the lower right of the estate, close to a pond or body of water outlined in pale blue. The composition features gently rolling hills and clusters of trees throughout the scene. Text at the bottom of the drawing reads: "ESTATE OF E.K. KNAPP — THE BLACKWELL SURVEY 1860."
title: Peter K. Knapp Estate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
